trigger: async/concurrency (threaded test of a cross-process fan-out barrier)

doubts.claim_under_doubt: Joiner writing markers only after the barrier's first poll guarantees a no-wait barrier finds them absent.
doubts.disproof_attempt: Not a flake, a regression-detection gap: the joiner could write during the barrier's first pass (os.open releases the GIL), so a single-pass barrier could pass.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: Gate the joiner on the barrier's second pass (call count > len(participants)). ADDRESSED and verified: no-barrier mutant and single-pass mutant both fail deterministically; 6/6 x3 pass; ruff clean.

summary: No concrete false-failure path survives: the marker scan returns False only on absence/non-empty marker, nothing deletes or writes markers, None (sharing violation) is deliberately ignored, wrapper is hit via module globals, worst-case hang is a 10s bounded wait. One low doubt (detection depends on scheduling) was fixed.
